title: Derivative of an arcsine series term
statement: For every natural number $j$ and real number $z$, the function $y\\mapsto c_j y^{2j+1}$ is differentiable at $z$ with derivative $\\frac{\\binom{2j}{j}}{2^{2j}}z^{2j}$, where $c_j=\\frac{\\binom{2j}{j}}{2^{2j}(2j+1)}$.
